gold: Giant cell tumor of soft tissue (GCT-ST)

selector.rationale: Histopathology showing multinodular proliferation of osteoclast-like multinucleated giant cells and mononuclear cells, positive for CD68, supports Giant Cell Tumor diagnosis

rejected.label: PALB2-related tumor
rejected.why: Lack of direct evidence linking PALB2 splicing variant to the patient's current presentation

rejected.label: Hodgkin Lymphoma
rejected.why: Patient's history of Hodgkin Lymphoma does not directly relate to current symptoms and histopathology findings

rejected.label: Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis
rejected.why: Contradictory evidence, including negative findings for certain markers and lack of specific Langerhans cell features

rejected.label: Rosai-Dorfman Disease
rejected.why: While some histopathological features are similar, the overall clinical and imaging findings better support Giant Cell Tumor
